target.title: fix: sidebar customization check reopens Settings
target.body:
AI-assisted: Codex implemented and reviewed this change.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the sidebar customization E2E test failed while reopening Settings after the Settings entry moved from a direct sidebar link into the agent-chip menu. The stale accessible-role lookup failed on Linux Chromium as well as the reported macOS/Node 26 setup.

## Why This Change Was Made

The test now follows the shipped interaction: open the agent menu, wait for its menu state, and activate the Settings menu item. Both Settings entry points in the scenario use the same helper; product behavior remains unchanged.

## User Impact

No runtime behavior changes. The sidebar customization E2E once again validates the current Settings takeover/search flow deterministically across Linux and macOS.

## Evidence

- Before: fresh Blacksmith Testbox Linux/Chromium run on then-current `main` reproduced the same failure: 1 failed, 5 passed; `getByRole("link", { name: "Settings" })` never became visible.
- After, exact branch head `4d6478376f533fbb2fcf9b391d2cf3b1b8c00f69`: `corepack pnpm test:ui:e2e -- ui/src/e2e/sidebar-customization.e2e.test.ts` — 6 passed, 0 failed, including the 5.1s target scenario. Testbox `tbx_01kxczkgn0kgpzvber2sh37y9c`; [Actions run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29226715185).
- Behavior contract: 4 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked; Settings takeover, search filtering/reset, and navigation-state persistence all passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Fresh `autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main` — no actionable findings; patch correct (0.96 confidence).
- Hosted CI is running on the final head. The only early failures are three platform-scope detector jobs blocked before checkout by GitHub App installation rate limiting; they are queued for rerun after the published reset.

Related: #105777
